title: Family Group Posing at Hoover Dam, 1930s Nevada Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A well-dressed American family of six stands along a concrete overlook wall at Hoover Dam during the late 1930s. The group includes two adult men in suits and hats, a mature woman in a patterned summer day dress, and three children leaning casually against the railing. High-voltage transmission towers and the rugged terrain of Black Canyon rise behind them, highlighting the era's fascination with New Deal public works engineering and the rise of mid-century automotive sightseeing.
